subject.title: [Bug]: delivery-recovery 0 recovered / N failed after gateway restart — recovery starts before channel transport ready

question: Should the remaining Feishu restart recovery problem be solved with a channel-owned reconnect drain after WebSocket readiness, a gateway-level startup recovery gate, or a retry reset policy?
rationale: All three approaches change recovery semantics; the source points to a real timing gap, but the safest product boundary and retry behavior need maintainer intent plus live Feishu proof.

options.title: Feishu reconnect drain after ready
options.body: Wire Feishu to the existing plugin SDK drainPendingDeliveries seam when its WebSocket reaches ready/reconnected, with focused source tests and live restart proof.

options.title: Gateway-level readiness gate
options.body: Delay generic startup recovery until channel readiness is known, accepting broader startup coupling across channels.

options.title: Retry reset or fixed delay
options.body: Adopt the reporter workaround style only if maintainers explicitly want restart to reset retry budget despite masking repeated real failures.

recommendation.title: Feishu reconnect drain after ready
recommendation.body: Wire Feishu to the existing plugin SDK drainPendingDeliveries seam when its WebSocket reaches ready/reconnected, with focused source tests and live restart proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They have strong history across both the outbound recovery split and Feishu monitor transport boundary.
